kpis.description_fr: Spikevax (mRNA-1273) : déclin endémique post-pandémie. Marché US/EU/JP commercialisé.
kpis.description_en: Spikevax (mRNA-1273): post-pandemic endemic decline. US/EU/JP commercial market.

kpis.description_fr: mResvia (mRNA-1345) : RSV vaccin older adults, approved 2024. Lancement challenged vs GSK/Pfizer.
kpis.description_en: mResvia (mRNA-1345): older adults RSV vaccine, 2024-approved. Launch challenged vs GSK/Pfizer.

kpis.description_fr: Programmes cliniques actifs (oncologie individualized, latent virus CMV, influenza, rare disease). Diversification post-COVID.
kpis.description_en: Active clinical programs (individualized oncology, CMV, flu, rare disease). Post-COVID diversification.

kpis.description_fr: Cash + investments. Burn rate élevé pendant pivot pipeline, 4 ans runway annoncé.
kpis.description_en: Cash + investments. High burn rate during pipeline pivot, 4-year runway announced.

kpis_story.description_fr: mRNA-4157 (V940) : vaccin cancer individualisé melanoma adjuvant + Keytruda. Phase 3 INTerpath en cours, BLA cible 2025-2026. Pari haut potentiel.
kpis_story.description_en: mRNA-4157 (V940): individualized melanoma cancer adjuvant vaccine + Keytruda. Phase 3 INTerpath ongoing, BLA target 2025-2026. High-potential bet.

kpis_story.description_fr: mRNA-1647 : vaccin CMV (cytomegalovirus). Phase 3 CMVictory readout attendu 2025. Pas de vaccin CMV existant, marché vierge.
kpis_story.description_en: mRNA-1647: CMV vaccine. Phase 3 CMVictory readout expected 2025. No existing CMV vaccine, greenfield market.

_notes: Moderna = mRNA platform. Pivot post-COVID vers oncology + latent virus + rare disease.
